title: Website Ownership: Domain, Hosting, Content, and Source Code

cover.alt: Concept illustration of an open case holding four website assets and an owner's key.

figures.title: Four layers to account for
figures.summary: Website control involves separate assets and accounts.

items.label: Domain
items.detail: Know which registrar account holds the address and who can manage it.

items.label: Hosting
items.detail: Confirm account ownership, billing access, and collaborator permissions.

items.label: Content
items.detail: Keep original files and records of the rights to use them.

items.label: Source code
items.detail: Confirm what the agreement delivers and how the files can be exported.

figures.caption: An asset inventory from the article. Your agreement and third-party licenses define the applicable rights.

figures.title: Verify access before you need a handoff
figures.summary: Test the practical access behind each ownership promise.

items.label: Sign in
items.detail: Confirm you can access the domain and hosting accounts yourself.

items.label: Check account details
items.detail: Review the contact, billing, and administrator information.

items.label: Retrieve the source
items.detail: Confirm the repository or agreed export can actually be downloaded.

items.label: Keep independent copies
items.detail: Store text, images, and relevant license records outside the live website.

figures.caption: A practical access check, not a determination of legal ownership. See the linked terms and service scope.
